title: Yonto index
description: A TVBox 仓 / XPTV index document, `{"sites": [...]}`, as far as Yonto reads it (kangzj/lantern-tv#606, docs/design/2026-09-23-the-app-reads-every-index.md). Yonto's own entries are `type` 50 and say what they are in `ext.yontoType`, with the type's payload in `ext.config`; every other entry is somebody else's and is described only enough to be told apart.
$comment: Lenient about everyone else's entries, because a curator merging ours into a stranger's 仓 must not be refused for the stranger's fields, and a reader skips and counts what it can't use rather than refusing the document. A type-50 entry's config is described by contracts/yonto-types/<yontoType>.schema.json where Yonto defines that type.

sites.description: Mirrored as IndexReader's MAX_ENTRIES on a device, which refuses a longer list rather than reading part of it.

not.$comment: FongMi reads `type` as an Integer and turns a string into an empty site, so a Yonto entry typed "50" is not the same entry to every reader. Other entries' string types are theirs to keep.

yontoEntry.description: A Yonto entry. 50 is the only number Yonto takes; a new kind of entry is a new `yontoType`, never a new number.

yontoType.description: What this entry is. A short id is Yonto's own and has a schema under contracts/yonto-types/; anybody else's type is reverse-DNS. A reader skips and counts a type it doesn't know.

pluginEntry.description: A `plugin` entry. `api` is the versioned zip with its sha256, exactly the link a viewer could paste. The four FongMi fields keep it out of that player's site list and search, which would otherwise read the zip as a CMS; they are required here and on no other Yonto type, whose catalogs FongMi may well read.

key.description: `yonto:<id>`, so a merged document can also carry somebody else's entry for the same site.
